title: Gricea: An Open Science Platform for Conversational AI Research
abstract: arXiv:2609.22039v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We need studies on conversational AI (CAI) at scale to understand human behavior and shape CAI design. However, fragmented reporting of systems and study configurations hinders replication, extension, and knowledge accumulation. We present Gricea, an open-science platform representing studies as configurable, deployable research artifacts that researchers can run, inspect, share, and reuse. Informed by a formative analysis of prior CAI research, Gricea couples study procedures, participant-facing systems, and conversational task behavior in. In a replication study using Gricea, we replicated configurations 93% of eligible CUI 2026 papers; while also flagging missing information in 96% of papers that hinder faithful replication --- further motivating Gricea's need. translated_title: Gricea：一个面向对话式人工智能研究的开放科学平台
translated_abstract: 我们需要大规模的对话式人工智能（CAI）研究来理解人类行为并塑造CAI设计。然而，系统与研究配置的碎片化报告阻碍了研究的复现、扩展和知识积累。我们提出了Gricea，一个开放科学平台，它将研究表示为可配置、可部署的研究工件，研究人员可以对这些工件进行运行、检查、共享和复用。基于对先前CAI研究的形成性分析，Gricea将研究流程、面向参与者的系统和对话任务行为耦合在一起。在使用Gricea开展的一项复现研究中，我们成功复现了93%符合条件的CUI 2026论文的配置；同时还标记出96%的论文中存在阻碍忠实复现的缺失信息——这进一步证明了Gricea的必要性。在一项用户研究中，来自不同背景的研究人员和从业者成功构建了可运行的研究，以解决各种开放式研究问题。
tldr: Gricea是一个开放科学平台，将对话式AI研究表示为可配置、可部署、可复用的研究工件，成功复现了93%的CUI 2026论文配置，解决了因研究配置碎片化报告而导致的复现与知识积累困难问题。
en_tdlr: Gricea is an open-science platform that represents conversational AI studies as configurable, deployable, and reusable research artifacts, successfully replicating 93% of eligible CUI 2026 paper configurations and addressing the reproducibility challenges caused by fragmented reporting of systems and study configurations.
